modes.name: scan
modes.purpose: Find security concerns in local source/configuration

modes.name: recon
modes.purpose: Map authorized assets and trust boundaries

modes.name: simulate
modes.purpose: Validate an invariant with approved synthetic controls

modes.name: hunt
modes.purpose: Analyze supplied telemetry and benign alternatives

modes.name: incident
modes.purpose: Reconstruct supported suspicious or compromised activity

modes.name: bounty
modes.purpose: Prepare policy-bound validation and submission evidence

modes.name: verify
modes.purpose: Recheck an existing finding against its invariant

mechanisms.agent: Mode cues interpreted by the selected skill; not shell commands.
mechanisms.installer: panda-suite install/update copies skill definitions; does not execute a mode.
mechanisms.helper: help/request validate a contract; scan-report normalizes supplied local results without launching scanners.
